mentions.name: Scryer
mentions.description: A desktop tool that brings model-driven development to AI coding agents. It systematizes the markdown specs people use into a model graph, anchors claims to code, and represents the result as a wiki. Planned changes to a codebase are surfaced as a diff of the model's definition, so you see a complete diff of everything the agent plans to do instead of reading its plan as an essay, making it possible to properly track what gets implemented and how. Still experimental.
mentions.problem: AI-generated code from intent/specs (vibe coding) is a blessing and a curse: agent plans read as essays, making it hard to keep track of what gets implemented and how
mentions.audience: Developers working with AI coding agents on real codebases; the author uses it for work and is seeking feedback from others
